title: Encoding a conjunction by a product
statement: Encode false as $0$ and true as $1$ in the two-element set with multiplication modulo $2$. For any finite list $l$ of natural numbers and any Boolean-valued function $f$ on the natural numbers, the product of the encodings of $f(l_j)$ over all positions $j$ in the list equals the encoding of the conjunction of the values $f(k)$ for $k$ in $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a finite list of natural numbers
$f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the natural numbers
